description: This file defines the IControlClient interface, an abstract class for receiving notifications about application state changes from the Rialto server. It includes a destructor and a pure virtual method notifyApplicationState, and is part of the firebolt::rialto namespace.

classes.name: IControlClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for Rialto control clients that receive notifications about application state changes.

methods.name: ~IControlClient
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IControlClient interface.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of a new application state.
